tool_args.rationale: The prior model failed due to attaching parameters to a function; this implementation uses fit-stored parameters and numerical least-squares fitting. The original five rows show a saturating response to u_now, while the paid contrast shows substantial gradient dependence. The chosen compact bridge model is fit to all available rows; confirmation can assess whether this stationary smooth approximation reaches tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Seven observations now include a deliberate gradient contrast; fitting a compact model is preferable to another costly measurement unless confirmation fails.
Those authorized alternatives do not explain the strong output variation under changed s_grad as well as a gradient-sensitive bridge response.
It is explicitly a nuisance measurement and is not relevant to resolving the observed bridge law.
